worklife-needs.label: Five Needs For Work & Life
worklife-needs.description: Rate how well your current role fulfills five core work-life needs — livelihood, integrity, connection, significance, and progression — and visualize the result as a flower.

nasa-moon-survival.label: NASA Moon Survival Exercise
nasa-moon-survival.description: A classic team-building exercise: rank 15 survival items after an emergency moon landing and compare your choices against NASA's expert ratings.
